keyword: maximum aggregate size on the pump order

title.en: Put the Aggregate Cell on the Xingtai Purchase Order
title.zh: 把骨料格子写进邢台的采购订单

description.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints maximum aggregate on some pump pages and leaves it off others. The inquiry still asks for your maximum aggregate. Do not copy a neighbour’s stone size onto a blank page.
description.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台的一些泵页印最大骨料，另一些不印。询盘仍然要求你的最大骨料。不要把邻页的石子粒径抄到空白页上。

h1.en: Order Against the Aggregate Cell That Is Actually Printed
h1.zh: 按实际印出的骨料格下单

directAnswer.en: When Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints a maximum aggregate, that cell is part of the order. Electric 20 prints 1–2 cm. Electric 15 prints 1–3 cm. Electric 80 prints 24 mm (≤ 2 cm). HBT8018 prints 4 cm and below. Diesel 120 and LZ-80 print 6 cm and below. Diesel 60 states that aggregate size is not printed. Send your measured maximum anyway, and do not fill Diesel 60’s blank from LZ-60’s 4 cm line.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械（邢台）印了最大骨料时，这一格就是订单的一部分。电动20印 1–2 cm。电动15印 1–3 cm。电动80印 24 mm（≤ 2 cm）。HBT8018 印 4 cm 及以下。柴油120和 LZ-80 印 6 cm 及以下。柴油60写明未印骨料粒径。你的实测最大值仍然要发送，但不要用 LZ-60 的 4 cm 去填柴油60的空白。

heading.en: B500S uses a material line, not a trailer aggregate line
heading.zh: B500S 用的是材料行，不是拖泵骨料行

body.en: B500S-83D prints sand and small stone, 5–16 mm. That is the material cell for the compact unit. It is not Electric 15’s 1–3 cm cell and not a licence to order a trailer pump for 16 mm only.
body.zh: B500S-83D 印砂和小石，5–16 mm。这是紧凑机的材料格。它不是电动15的 1–3 cm，也不能据此只为 16 mm 去订一台拖泵。

heading.en: Description notes that are not a second cell
heading.zh: 说明里的注释不是第二格

body.en: Diesel 30’s description mentions 1 cm aggregate beside 60 m / 180 m, while the specification cell says 3 cm and below. Diesel 40 and Diesel 50 descriptions mention 1 cm aggregate beside the distance, without a separate maximum-aggregate specification row. Quote both published wordings and add your stone size.
body.zh: 柴油30的说明在 60 m / 180 m 旁提到 1 cm 骨料，规格格则写 3 cm 及以下。柴油40和柴油50的说明在距离旁提到 1 cm 骨料，没有单独的最大骨料规格行。两处已公布文字都要引用，并加上你的石子粒径。

heading.en: The inquiry field is mandatory in the factory wording
heading.zh: 工厂口径里这一项是要发送的

body.en: Category pages ask for maximum aggregate together with output and distance. Send it to [/en/contact/](/en/contact/) even when you also paste the printed cell. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not print a price that changes by millimetre on the site.
body.zh: 分类页要求最大骨料和输送量、距离一起发送。即使你已经贴了印出的格子，仍要发到 [/zh/contact/](/zh/contact/)。河北品锦机械没有在网站上印按毫米变化的价格。

question.en: Is 4 cm on the mixer the same as 4 cm on HBT8018?
question.zh: 搅拌泵上的 4 cm 和 HBT8018 的 4 cm 是同一台机器吗？

answer.en: No. The electric mixer prints aggregate 4 cm and below on its own sheet. HBT8018 prints 4 cm and below on a pump-only page with 132 kW.
answer.zh: 不是。电动搅拌泵在自己的表上印骨料 4 cm 及以下。HBT8018 在只泵送的页面上印 4 cm 及以下，电机是 132 kW。

question.zh: 电动10系列印 2 cm 吗？

answer.en: It prints 2 cm and below, with hopper 0.1 m³.
answer.zh: 它印 2 cm 及以下，料斗 0.1 m³。

question.en: What if the page is blank?

answer.en: Leave the catalogue cell blank. Send the measured stone as your site fact.
answer.zh: 目录格保持空白。把实测石子作为现场事实发送。

question.en: Are sprayer particle sizes pump aggregate?
question.zh: 喷涂机粒径是泵的骨料吗？

answer.en: No. A ≤6 mm sprayer particle is a spraying-machine cell. It does not rewrite a trailer pump.
answer.zh: 不是。喷涂机的 ≤6 mm 粒径是喷涂机格子。它不改写拖泵。
